unit: Materials Research Science and Engineering Center (MRSEC)
notes: Cross-cutting NSF-funded center (two Interdisciplinary Research Groups: IRG1 Self-Limiting Assembly, IRG2 Soft Active Materials). Its 'MRSEC Primary Participants' faculty list includes Brandeis PIs already recorded under their home department (Aparna Baskaran, Bulbul Chakraborty, Hannah Yevick, Jane Kondev, Michael Hagan -> brandeis-physics; Niels Bradshaw -> brandeis-biochemistry; Avital Rodal, Bruce Goode -> brandeis-biology; Pengyu Hong -> brandeis-computer-science; Grace Han, Bing Xu -> brandeis-chemistry) plus several external collaborators (Andreas Bausch/TU Munich, Hendrik Dietz/TU Munich, Greg Grason/UMass Amherst, Ryan Hayward/UMass Amherst, Guillaume Duclos) outside this Boston/Cambridge-area directory's scope. Not duplicating Brandeis PIs here to avoid double-counting.
